english: Let $S$ be the point $(3,0)$ and let $L$ be the line $x=\dfrac{16}{3}$. Let $T$ be the set of all integers $\lambda$ for which the point $P(\lambda,\lambda+1)$ satisfies $PS<\dfrac34\,PN$, where $N$ is the foot of the perpendicular from $P$ to $L$. Then the sum of all the elements of $T$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $S$ बिन्दु $(3,0)$ है तथा $L$ रेखा $x=\dfrac{16}{3}$ है। माना $T$ उन सभी पूर्णांकों $\lambda$ का समुच्चय है जिनके लिए बिन्दु $P(\lambda,\lambda+1)$ प्रतिबन्ध $PS<\dfrac34\,PN$ को सन्तुष्ट करता है, जहाँ $N$ बिन्दु $P$ से $L$ पर डाले गए लम्ब का पाद है। तब $T$ के सभी अवयवों का योग ______ है।
solution: $PS=\dfrac34PN$ is the ellipse with focus $(3,0)$, directrix $x=\dfrac{16}{3}$, $e=\dfrac34$: $ae=3$, $\dfrac ae=\dfrac{16}{3}\Rightarrow a=4$, $b^{2}=16-9=7$
solution_full: The locus $PS=\dfrac34PN$ is the ellipse with focus $S(3,0)$, directrix $x=\dfrac{16}{3}$ and $e=\dfrac34$. For the standard ellipse centred at the origin, $ae=3$ and $\dfrac ae=\dfrac{16}{3}$ give $a^{2}=16$, $a=4$, and $b^{2}=a^{2}(1-e^{2})=16\cdot\dfrac{7}{16}=7$.
So $PS<\dfrac34PN$ exactly when $S_1=\dfrac{x^{2}}{16}+\dfrac{y^{2}}{7}-1<0$, i.e. when $P$ lies inside the ellipse.

The roots are $\dfrac{-32\pm\sqrt{1024+8832}}{46}=\dfrac{-32\pm\sqrt{9856}}{46}$, about $-2.85$ and $1.46$. Check the boundary integers: $\lambda=-3$ gives $207-96-96=15>0$; $\lambda=2$ gives $92+64-96=60>0$; $\lambda=-2$ gives $92-64-96<0$; $\lambda=1$ gives $23+32-96<0$.
originality_note: New: the position test is hidden inside a focus-directrix inequality, so the student must recognise PS < e PN as the interior of an ellipse and identify that ellipse from its focus and directrix (way 4, hidden structure). Closest known: integer values of a parameter for which a point lies inside an ellipse. Different because: the ellipse is never written; it has to be built from the basic elements, and the identity PS^2 - e^2 PN^2 = (1 - e^2)a^2 S1 converts the inequality.
stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol, point and curve introduced, conditions complete, one reading of each sentence; answer recomputed with sympy and unique; answer matches the plan. Checked that the inequality is equivalent to the interior for every point of the plane (identity verified symbolically), and the boundary integers -3 and 2. Changed: No change.
key_step: Recognise PS = (3/4)PN as x^2/16 + y^2/7 = 1, so the condition is S1 < 0.
justification: Short chain: identify the ellipse from focus, directrix and e, then a quadratic inequality and an integer count; the hidden ellipse is the only idea. Comparable to 2021-P1-Q17 (L1) and 2024-P1-Q8 (L2) in effort; L2.
blueprint_concepts: Position of a point wrt a Ellipse
Basic elements of the standard ellipse: focus, directrix, axis, latus rectum

concept_use.Position of a point wrt a Ellipse: The inequality PS < (3/4)PN is turned into S1 < 0, i.e. the point (lambda, lambda + 1) must lie inside x^2/16 + y^2/7 = 1, giving 23 lambda^2 + 32 lambda - 96 < 0.
concept_use.Basic elements of the standard ellipse:: The focus (3,0), the directrix x = 16/3 and e = 3/4 identify the ellipse: ae = 3, a/e = 16/3, so a = 4 and b^2 = 7.
